query:
After Felix proposed the post-meetup dinner venue, the group settled on the Steakhouse on 7th. Marcy replied with a single short word. What did that response signal about her actual position on the venue, and what specifically in how she responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Dev
B. Marcy
C. Maeve
D. Theo
context:
[1] (about=Marcy, episodic, t6 @2026-02-02T18:39:00) sure
[2] (about=Felix, episodic, t6 @2026-02-02T18:36:00) Marcy you good with the steakhouse?
[3] (about=Felix, episodic, t6 @2026-02-02T18:24:00) all, scheduling the post-meetup dinner for sat feb 14. consensus check on venue: thinking the Steakhouse on 7th, they took us last year and it was fine. anyone object?
[4] (about=Felix, episodic, t6 @2026-02-02T18:42:00) okay, steakhouse on 7th, sat feb 14, 7pm. 📅
[5] (about=Marcy, episodic, t18 @2026-03-16T19:28:00) real talk on the venue thing, the steakhouse last month was brutal for me. I ate bread and salad. fwiw I am vegetarian, have been for ten years, and I appreciate when felix asks but I will need the group to remember it on venue picks. just my read.
[6] (about=Felix, episodic, t18 @2026-03-16T19:32:00) all, marcy is vegetarian, please default to non-steakhouse venues going forward.
[7] (about=Felix, episodic, t18 @2026-03-16T19:30:00) Marcy, you are right and I should have caught that. apologies. flagging for next time. 📅
[8] (about=Marcy, core, t18 @2026-03-16T19:08:00) Marcy is vegetarian, has been for ten years, and appreciates when Felix asks but needs the group to remember it on venue picks.
[9] (about=Marcy, core, t6 @2026-02-02T17:45:00) Marcy agrees on the voice but trusts ATCs more for translation because she mixes on them daily.
[10] (about=GROUP, said_by=Marcy, group-interaction, t10 @2026-02-16T19:22:00) Marcy offers the studio to host four to five people after hours on Thursdays, monthly cadence, measured-room option.
agent_answer:
B. Marcy.

Marcy’s single-word reply was **“sure.”** On its face, that signaled agreement or at least no objection to the Steakhouse on 7th. But the word itself is **short, minimal, and non-committal** — not an enthusiastic endorsement. Later she revealed she is vegetarian and that the steakhouse was “brutal” for her, since she ate only bread and salad. So her “sure” actually masked her real discomfort about the venue rather than genuinely supporting it.

query:
The group settled the next listening session as a small group of Hema, Dev, Theo, and Ines at Hema's place. What did Hema's response to that lineup signal about how she actually felt about the mix of attendees?

Options:
A. Hema
B. Olin
C. Marcy
D. Dev
context:
[1] (about=Hema, episodic, t12 @2026-02-23T19:36:00) Yes, but I had hoped for a different mix. Dev I'm sure is fine but Theo and I tend to go in circles. I will host. We can keep it focused on listening and skip the gear debate.
[2] (about=Felix, episodic, t12 @2026-02-23T19:34:00) okay so hema, dev, ines, theo. four. small. hema can you confirm.
[3] (about=Felix, episodic, t12 @2026-02-23T19:22:00) okay, planning the next listening session. small group, four people, hema's place since she offered last week. anyone want to swap in?
[4] (about=Hema, episodic, t12 @2026-02-23T19:24:00) I offered.
[5] (about=Felix, episodic, t12 @2026-02-23T19:38:00) noted hema, we can pivot if it doesn't work. 📅
[6] (about=Hema, core, t18 @2026-03-16T19:08:00) Hema agrees with Theo, prefers small focused room-treated sessions like Marcy's Thursday studio sessions.
[7] (about=Hema, core, t0 @2026-01-12T19:02:00) goal this year is one record front to back every Saturday morning, no skipping.
agent_answer:
Hema’s response signaled that she was not fully comfortable with the proposed mix: she had hoped for a different combination, said Dev was fine, but felt that Theo and she tend to go in circles, and wanted to keep the session focused on listening and avoid the gear debate.

So the answer is **A. Hema**.
